description: Use Mantok in ChatGPT and Codex to organize tasks for yourself or your team. View your authorized organizations, members, tasks, notifications, and meetings. Create, assign, comment on, and track tasks after confirming changes. Turn text you provide into a meeting draft with topics, notes, decisions, and actions. Confirm participants and review the proposed tasks before finalizing. Only actions become private tasks, each assigned to one meeting participant. Access respects your organization permissions. No audio recording or attachment access.

defaultPrompt: Mostre minhas tarefas abertas e destaque as urgentes.
Organize este texto em um rascunho de reunião no Mantok, confirmando os convidados e os cards comigo.
Mostre a prévia das tarefas desta reunião antes de pedir minha confirmação para finalizar.
